name: Regular Church Attendance
overview: Scripture emphasizes the joy and importance of gathering in the house of the Lord, as expressed in Psalms 122:1 and exemplified by Jesus' regular attendance at synagogue (Luke 4:16). The church, established by Christ as a firm foundation (Matthew 16:18), is a community where believers meet in His name, assured of His presence among them (Matthew 18:20). Early Christians exemplified steadfast commitment to fellowship, teaching, prayer, and shared meals (Acts 2:42), reflecting a pattern of regular, faithful assembly that aligns with seeking first the kingdom of God and His righteousness (Matthew 6:33).
